{{Short description|Overview about the NUTS statistical regions of}}
As a member of the [[European Free Trade Association|EFTA]], '''[[Liechtenstein]]''' (LI) is included in the '''[[Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics]] (NUTS)'''. The three NUTS levels all correspond to the country itself:
* NUTS-1: LI0 Liechtenstein
* NUTS-2: LI00 Liechtenstein
* NUTS-3: LI000 Liechtenstein

Below the NUTS levels, there are [[local administrative unit|LAU]]: [[municipalities of Liechtenstein|municipalities]].
